result:
All 14 queries ran and gave plausible answers on the sample files. The J2 and J6 totals match hand checks, but I didn't hand-check the rest.

- **J8:** the `hr` department's empty-skills case is handled by the `[]` fallback. Its output showed `"hr":["excel"]`, so I didn't see an empty array come out.
- **J13:** the query drops `#` comment lines before matching `==`. It doesn't trim whitespace.

H1: /data | filter ~(/active | eq true) | filter ~(at :address | if (type | eq ::map) ~(at :city | type | eq ::string) ~(false)) | sort ~(/name | lower) | * /name
H2: filter ~(at :status | if (type | eq ::string) ~(lower | eq "paid") ~(false)) | * (/items * (mul /qty /price)) | flat | sum | round 2
H3: :d /devDependencies | /dependencies | union d | filter ~(startsWith "^") | :m / | keys | sort | * (:k / | [(keyword) (m | at k)] | join "@")
H4: filter ~(/state | eq "open") | groupBy ~(at :assignee | if (type | eq ::map) ~(/login) ~("unassigned")) | * count
H5: :d /defaults | /services | filter ~(at :enabled | ne false) | * {:name /name :timeout (coalesce ~(/timeout) ~(d | /timeout)) :retries (coalesce ~(/retries) ~(d | /retries))} | sort ~/name
H6: filter ~(at :durationMs | type | eq ::number) | groupBy ~/service | * (:g / | (* /durationMs | sum) | div (g | count) | round 1)
H7: filter ~(at :stock | if (type | eq ::number) ~(gt 0) ~(false)) | sort ~/price | reverse | take 3 | * /name
H8: groupBy ~/dept | * (* (at :skills | if (type | eq ::vec) ~(/) ~([])) | flat | * lower | distinct | sort)
H9: filter ~(/role | lower | eq "db") | every ~([(/region | eq "eu-west") (at :cpu | if (type | eq ::map) ~(at :cores | if (type | eq ::number) ~(gte 8) ~(false)) ~(false))] | every ~(/))
H10: "Alice@Example.com, bob@test.org; carol@EXAMPLE.com, dave@mail.net; erin@Test.org, frank@example.com" | split ";" | * (split ",") | flat | * (split "@" | last | lower | split " " | first) | distinct | sort
H11: lines | filter ~(count | gt 0) | * (split " ") | filter ~(/3 | parseJson | gte 500) | groupBy ~/2 | * count | :m / | keys | * (:k / | {:path (keyword) :count (m | at k)}) | sort ~([(/count | mul -1) /path]) | take 2
H12: lines | drop 1 | filter ~(count | gt 0) | * (split ",") | filter ~(/2 | count | gt 0) | * {:team /1 :score (/2 | parseJson)} | groupBy ~/team | * (:g / | (* /score | sum) | div (g | count) | round 2)
H13: lines | filter ~(startsWith "#" | not) | filter ~(contains "==") | * (split "==" | [(/0 | lower) /1]) | groupBy ~/0 | * (first | /1)
H14: * {:t /title :l (at :comments | if (type | eq ::vec) ~(* (at :likes | if (type | eq ::number) ~(/) ~(0)) | sum) ~(0))} | sort ~/l | last | /t
